review.candidate_sales: Actual LP total partitioned by effective thermal MW or renewable available output; does not require sector incremental sales
review.thermal_fuel: Candidate fuel calculated using candidate efficiency; physical total still harmonic by common utilisation
review.support: Thermal quote receives candidate own annualised hours and explicit support fraction; renewable screening receives own hours
review.incumbents: Remaining LP sales allocated to incumbents; actual cohort operating accounts expose lower incumbent revenue without charging it to candidate
review.joint_screen: Inherited finite shrink/remove/rescreen remains in force with revised project economics
review.finance: Representative sector cash/debt pool remains; no separate firm property rights or independent entrant finance is inferred

identified_boundary: Original sector ledger uses ETS cash inflows positive (negative payment); project ETS transfer must use the same sign and profit must add the transfer
limits: Cohort records before support do not themselves attribute support cash received or debt service to independent firms
Within-technology common utilisation cannot represent efficient-unit merit order
First positive operating-year forecast is extended by PV assumption; it does not model later entrant competition over the entire plant life
